verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a hosted cap-table SaaS. Publishing source under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a public repository, an open-source license, or source availability; the docs cover only proprietary hosted features, a read-only MCP connection, and pricing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
